evidence.label: 描述任务、问题或评测环境
evidence.excerpt: High-resolution visual question answering often fails because a multimodal model does not acquire the small, spatially localized evidence needed to answer a question.

evidence.label: 描述评分指标或评测协议
evidence.excerpt: We introduce VPS, a visual parallel-search framework in which a main agent first invokes grid_search to inspect image tiles in parallel with question-conditioned sub-agents, and then adaptively invokes zoom_in PSisual Parallel Search improves mean accuracy over dedicated zoom-only search in 14 of 15 same-model comparisons, with gains up to 8.0 points and especially strong improvements for smaller main models.
